A useful AI project can start with a paper scoresheet.

At ShellHacks, Anna Abyzova and I built Snap to League. Gemini extracts teams and scores; application code computes standings; the organizer checks the draft before publishing.

The review step matters. Handwriting, typos and similar names need attention. Another photo opens a comparison, so the organizer can inspect changes.

EasyChamp existed before the event. Our hackathon work adds photo import, review and reconciliation on top of that platform.
